entries.note: The claim has a testable core despite the subjective praise.

entries.test: Public departure announcements and reporting on Karpathy's role would establish whether he left OpenAI in February 2024 and co-led its new agent project.

entries.test: Timestamped incident reports, contemporaneous ChatGPT outputs, and explanations available by publication would establish the malfunction's duration and how much remained unexplained.
entries.note: The question mark explicitly doubts the six-hour duration; 'roughly six hours' converts that doubt into an affirmative estimate.

entries.test: Comparable public evaluations of Google, Mistral, and GPT-4 models before and during the preceding two weeks would show whether the performance gap narrowed.
entries.note: 'Have closed the gap' suggests achieved parity more strongly than the source's claim of closing the gap.

entries.test: Kambhampati's contemporaneous research results would show whether tested failures or sensitivity to variations undermine claims of robust chain-of-thought prompting.
entries.note: This asserts that research supplies contrary evidence, rather than merely reporting someone's private doubts.
